//review: paths.include/exclude defines the shared reviewable repository universe for every reviewer; backendRoots/frontendRoots then route eligible files to domain reviewers. An EMPTY frontendRoots array means frontend-security-reviewer and frontend-performance-reviewer are never selected; an EMPTY backendRoots array similarly disables backend domain reviewers. Omit paths to preserve legacy reviewer selection. trustBoundaries, shortcutTracking, and accessibility configure reviewer context.
